MANILA, Philippines — One Filipino was reported missing and another hospitalized from the Tai Po fire incident in Hong Kong, the Department of Foreign Affairs (DFA) said late Thursday.

The Philippine Consulate General in Hong Kong continues to coordinate with local authorities to "determine the whereabouts of one [unidentified] missing Filipino," the DFA said.
